\paragraph{Routing rank.}
At each configuration’s best eligible LR, ungated R2O2-c reaches $82.2$ [$81.4$--$82.6$], against $69.4$ [$61.2$--$79.3$] for R1O1-c, with disjoint seed ranges. For real rows, gated R2O2-r reaches $82.0$, but ungated R2O2-r, at $60.3$, falls below R1O1-r ($67.0$) on average.
The ungated rank-one HM mixture also reaches $80.6$ [$79.8$--$81.4$]. These configuration comparisons do not isolate the effect of routing rank (Figure~\ref{fig:mqmkvar_final_points}).
